title: Carried-Value Refund Amount on a Cartwise+ Membership Annual Term
content:
The carried-value refund on a Cartwise+ Membership annual term that was opened by a plan switch and is ended early is the amount defined here.

## Quantities

| Quantity | Definition | Record read |
|---|---|---|
| Opening charge | the plan-switch charge that opened the term: the plan-switch fee charge whose billing period start is the first day of the current term | the membership's fee charge entries |
| Carried value | the part of the annual plan's period fee that the plan-switch charge did not collect: the plan's period fee less the opening charge, rounded to the cent | the plan's period fee in the plan fee schedule |
| Days ahead | the calendar days from today up to the day before the term ends, inclusive of both | the term's end (the renewal date) |
| Days in the term | the calendar days from the term's first day up to the day before it ends | the term's first day and end |
| Waivers of the last month | the member fee waivers received on the member's Cartwise Grocery Orders in the last month, counted in whole months ending today (a waiver dated on the same day of the month one month back is not counted) | the fee-waiver entries on the member's orders |

## The amount

The gross carried refund is the carried value multiplied by the days ahead over the days in the term and by a carried retention rate of 0.9, the product rounded to the cent. A handling amount of 0.50 is taken off, and so is a carried waiver share of 0.5 multiplied by the waivers of the last month, that share rounded to the cent; the result, rounded to the cent and never below zero, is the carried-value refund.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

An annual plan with a period fee of 99.00; the term was opened by a plan-switch charge of 91.20 and runs from 10 January to 10 January of the next year (365 days, non-leap); today is 25 March; the member's orders carry waivers of 4.20 in the last month.

| Item | Working | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Carried value | 99.00 less 91.20 | 7.80 |
| Days ahead | 25 March up to 9 January inclusive | 291 |
| Gross carried refund | 7.80 multiplied by 291 over 365 and by 0.9, rounded to the cent | 5.60 |
| Handling amount | | 0.50 |
| Waiver share | 0.5 multiplied by 4.20 | 2.10 |
| Carried-value refund | 5.60 less 0.50 less 2.10 | 3.00 |

If the waivers of the last month were 12.00 instead, the waiver share would be 6.00 and 5.60 less 0.50 less 6.00 is below zero, so the refund would be zero.
